_note: Sort and search dialogs layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255. theme and close_button.style are handed to PopUI as they are, so their keys keep PopUI's names. Offsets are from the panel's top left unless named otherwise.

close_button._note: The round close button on the panel's top right corner: x is panel right - inset_right, y is panel top - above.

sort._note: Panel height = header_h + one row_h per method + footer_h. The three direction buttons sit against the right margin; the method label fills the space left of them, less label_gap.

search._note: Panel height = header_h + 6 rows of row_h + footer_h. Fields start at field_x and end margin_x before the panel's right edge; widget y offsets are from their row's top.
